name: Adil R. Mallick
headline: Computer Science student building reliable cloud, data, and full-stack systems

education.organization: Michigan State University, College of Engineering
education.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Minor in Business

bullets.text: Coursework: Data Structures and Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Database Systems, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

Architected a containerized FastAPI inference service with Python and Docker, decoupling GPU-based satellite imagery segmentation from a Kubernetes-orchestrated ML pipeline and reducing model validation cycles from hours to minutes.
Deployed GPU-backed inference on AWS EC2 and abstracted AWS SQS, SNS, and database dependencies behind a stateless HTTP interface.
Drove migration of pipeline object storage from HERE's Open Location Platform to Amazon S3 across 20 deployment environments with no production downtime.
Provisioned Azure Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and alerting infrastructure with Terraform across enterprise environments.
Developed a Python REST API with Application Insights, managed identity authentication, Cosmos DB, and Key Vault.
Co-developed certificate automation that tracked SSL renewal status and alerted on expiring certificates across multi-environment CI/CD deployments.
Shipped a Microsoft Teams chatbot for more than 500 enterprise users as a TypeScript Azure Function with Power Automate, ServiceNow REST APIs, and Azure API Management.
Debugged REST routing and validated JSON payloads with Postman, cutting chatbot query response time by 27 percent.

Built cross-platform task-management features for a desktop productivity app published on the Mac App Store and Microsoft Store, offloading main-process work through Electron IPC to cut measured idle RAM use by 35 percent.
Automated email-list data workflows with Python, smtplib, and pandas.

projects.title: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers

bullets.text: Cut data-quality report latency from 2.1 seconds to 95 milliseconds at 100,000 rows by replacing in-memory aggregation with indexed PostgreSQL GROUP BY queries, verified against a Testcontainers PostgreSQL instance.
Built a Kotlin provider simulator serving Tesla-, Ford-, and SmartCar-shaped APIs with divergent JSON schemas, authentication styles, error envelopes, and runtime fault injection.

projects.title: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis Streams, FastAPI

bullets.text: Built a local-first pipeline that ingests job feeds, resolves descriptions, extracts structured requirements, retrieves resume evidence, produces cited matches, and reports aggregate skill gaps.

Implemented reliable fetching with Redis consumer groups, stale-message recovery, per-host rate limits, retries, circuit breakers, dead-letter handling, and dedicated public JSON adapters for four applicant-tracking systems.
Added versioned evidence retrieval with pgvector embeddings, mandatory citations, deterministic ranking, gap reports, a daily digest, and Python and Go CI checks.
Built a Python pipeline that ingests JSON and JSONL data, validates records with explicit rejection reasons, transforms features, trains a model, and emits reports.
Added reproducible preprocessing, pytest coverage, Docker execution, and GitHub Actions checks across Python versions with an end-to-end smoke test.
Built a geospatial data path from Python ingestion through an Express REST API and MongoDB GeoJSON indexes to a React dashboard.
Implemented geospatial-near search, filtering, pagination, statistics, CRUD operations, structured logging, centralized errors, and input validation.
Implemented differentially private federated averaging on MNIST with simulated clients, clipped model updates, Gaussian noise, and decentralized raw client data.
Added a Renyi differential privacy accountant and experiment sweeps to measure privacy-utility tradeoffs across noise settings.
Built a React and Express application for cataloging API endpoints and assessing privacy risk across six dimensions with findings, remediation tracking, charts, reports, and CSV export.
Implemented MongoDB persistence, JWT sessions, bcrypt password hashing, and role-based access for administrator, reviewer, and viewer roles.
Built a recursive raytracer in C++ using object-oriented design, implementing reflection, refraction, Phong shading, hard shadows, textures, and an OpenGL preview.

Built the volunteer recruitment pipeline and coordinated logistics for a public food bank in the Michigan State University Union for a council that secured more than $1 million in Michigan MiLeap grant funding.
